title: AI chatbot By RED HUB
script:
game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "AI Chatbot Script",
    Text = "Loading script, please wait...",
    Duration = 3
})

task.wait(1)

loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NOOB-IIT/Script-/bcdccf366f3da967f3857f41b149455bd5fe40db/AI%20chatbot"))()
features:
Module Type: Universal In-Game AI Chat Assistant

Functionality: 24/7 Automated Answering & Conversational Chat

Trigger Mechanism: Real-Time Global & Private Chat Detection

Interface: Simple Toggle GUI & Quick-Control Panel

Response Engine: Instant Question-Answering Logic

Smart In-Game AI Assistant Script
A continuous auto-answering script that turns your in-game chat into a live AI assistant. It listens to everything said in the server chat and instantly generates accurate, human-like answers to whatever any player asks or says.

Key Features:

Instant Auto-Answering: Automatically replies to any question, prompt, or statement typed by other players in real-time.

Full Chat Awareness: Monitors global server messages and direct chats to ensure no player query goes unanswered.
Smart Conversational Bot: Functions as a fully reactive AI entity capable of chatting on any topic smoothly.

Filter-Safe Outputs: Formats responses to fit game chat systems clean and un-censored.

One-Click Toggle GUI: Features a basic, lightweight UI that lets you enable, disable, or pause the AI auto-responder with a single tap.
